description: This file defines a utility service class for Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) in a Flutter project. It provides methods to ensure Firebase initialization, request notification permissions, and retrieve the device's FCM token, primarily for push notification testing and management.

classes.name: FirebaseMessagingService
classes.description: A helper utility class for handling Firebase Cloud Messaging setup and token management in a Flutter app.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes Firebase if not already initialized; safe to call multiple times.

methods.name: requestPermission
methods.description: Requests notification permissions from the user (mainly for iOS) and returns the settings.

methods.name: getDeviceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current device's FCM token for push notification registration.
